content:
maya: Quick heads-up  planning a small staged publish for py/ts SDKs to push 1.5.2-rc.2 and mark the sync client deprecated. Intend to push a short-lived dist-tag to our mirror registry and public registry. Rolling in 30m unless objections.
tony: ok from release side. what's the dist-tag so CI can pin?
yuki: propose `staged-partner-2103-2` so partners can pin to the mirror without hitting public `latest`.
liam: note: mirror replication has ~2-5m lag; we'll publish to mirror first, then to public registry after integration smoke. If mirror lag >10m we should abort and yank the mirror tag.
maya: publish plan: 1) build wheels -> testpypi 2) npm pack -> publish to mirror with `--tag staged-partner-2103-2` 3) after mirror smoke, publish to public npm with same tag 4) run integration smoke + perf harness. Rollback: immediate remove dist-tag on mirror or unpublish from mirror if checksum/sign issues; prefer tag removal over unpublish for audit.
deply-bot: [175432-175433] publish job queued: py(jb_17543) / npm(nb_17543) :rocket:
tony: rollback thresholds: immediate yank on any 403/auth or `signer-mismatch`; runtime revert if 5xx > 0.5% in first 5m or median SDK latency +200ms. Also abort promotion to public registry if mirror replication lag >10m.
yuki: deprecation wording ready: "The legacy sync client (`@redwood/sdk-sync`) is deprecated and will be removed in a future release. Migrate to the unified async client. Migration: https://redwood.ai/migrate-sync. Removal window: 90 days."
maya: adding that to CHANGELOG and npm `deprecated` field before publish. Also adding a docs PR to update examples.
deploy-bot: [175433-175434] py -> testpypi SUCCESS (jb_17543). sha256: d1a2b3...
maya: publishing to mirror now.
deploy-bot: [175434-175435] npm publish -> mirror (nb_17543) SUCCESS. dist-tag set -> staged-partner-2103-2
liam: monitoring mirror replication; current lag 1m. kicking off pinned e2e pulled from mirror.
deploy-bot: [175435-175436] mirror-smoke started (is_17543)
yuki: small note for security: we updated license headers in a few files; security-oncall, pls ack that the new headers are acceptable for partner redistribution.
security-oncall: acked. headers good.
tony: build infra noticed a tar ordering warning but artifact sha still matched. file ticket INFRA-4521 to track nondeterministic pack ordering; don't block this publish.
maya: mirror smoke looks clean so far (3m): 0.04% 5xx, median latency +8ms. Proceeding to publish to public registry now.
deploy-bot: [175436-175437] npm publish -> public (nb_17543_pub) RESTARTED -> FAILED: registry rate-limit 429 from npm when setting tag. logs: `EAI_AGAIN / registry.npmjs.org`
liam: hmm network dip. we'll retry with exponential backoff up to 3 attempts; if still 429 after 3 tries, we'll leave mirror tag in place and postpone public promotion.
yuki: agree. do not remove mirror tag unless checksum or signer issues.
maya: re-trying public publish now.
deploy-bot: [175437-175438] npm publish -> public (nb_17543_pub) RE-ATTEMPT 2 -> SUCCESS. dist-tag set -> staged-partner-2103-2 on public registry
tony: good. running integration-suite against public artifact now and leaving mirror tag for 24h TTL.
deploy-bot: [175438-175439] integration-suite started (is_17543)
liam: watching metrics: first 5m stable. 0.06% 5xx, median latency +11ms. within rollback window.
yuki: marketing/comm request: short technical blurb that includes migration link + 90-day removal. I'll draft and push to comms.
yuki: draft: "Developer preview: 1.5.2-rc.2 now available for partner testing under dist-tag `staged-partner-2103-2`. Legacy sync client `@redwood/sdk-sync` is deprecated; see migration guide. Scheduled removal: 90 days."
maya: follow-ups captured: INFRA-4521 (pack ordering), REL-291 (auto-clean mirror tag after TTL), DOCS-108 (update examples), and release-board note to remove deprecated package page in 90d.
deploy-bot: [175439-1754324500] integration-suite COMPLETE: PASS (is_17543). No signer or checksum issues.
maya: closing thread. summary: RC published -> staged-partner-2103-2, published to mirror then public, transient rate-limit on public registry handled by retry, mirror tag TTL=24h, docs + changelog updated, deprecation note live. Leaving tag for 24h then reconcile/promote to `canary` if no regressions. :white_check_mark:
